visualCharacteristics.purpose: Edge-to-edge row of images that open full size in an accessible lightbox
visualCharacteristics.layout: Images stack on mobile and share one row from 600px; lightbox is a native modal dialog with previous/next, Escape to close and trapped focus

contentPattern.structure: one row per image; the cell holds the image, optionally a link to the full-size file (wrapping the image or as a separate link) and an optional caption paragraph
contentPattern.example: 3 office images opening in a lightbox

notes: Total rewards: two 3-up rows between icon-tile sections, authored as 'Gallery'
Growth & development: one 3-up row after the text banner, authored as 'Gallery'
Culture of belonging: one 3-up row (div.dei_cards), authored as 'Gallery'

reuseGuidance: Use for any image row that should enlarge on click. Without a full-size link the lightbox shows a large optimized rendition of the same image. No third-party scripts.
